title: Separating Capability from Confidence: Grounded Dual-State Calibration for GRPO-Trained Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) require confidence that reflects both answer correctness and patient-specific visual evidence. Recent GRPO-based methods optimize verbalized confidence together with answer generation. However, this joint optimization may interfere with answer learning and drive confidence toward near-binary values. Verbalized confidence also provides no explicit assessment of visual support. We therefore separate capability learning from confidence estimation and propose \textbf{DualRead}. DualRead builds on the insight that reliability can be read from the actor's internal states at critical moments in the answering process. It freezes the GRPO-trained actor and combines pre-answer solvability with a post-answer assessment of the generated answer and its visual support. translated_title: 将能力与置信度分离：面向GRPO训练医学视觉语言模型的基于视觉证据的双状态校准
translated_abstract: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）需要其置信度能够同时反映答案的正确性和患者特定的视觉证据。近年来基于GRPO的方法将言语化置信度与答案生成联合优化。然而，这种联合优化可能干扰答案的学习，并使置信度趋向于接近二值的取值。此外，言语化置信度也无法提供对视觉支持的显式评估。因此，我们将能力学习与置信度估计相分离，提出了DualRead。DualRead建立在一个关键洞察之上：可靠性可以从actor在回答过程中的关键时刻的内部状态中读取。该方法冻结经过GRPO训练的actor，将回答前的可解性评估与回答后对生成答案及其视觉支持的评估相结合。为了进一步评估置信度是否真正反映了视觉依据，我们引入了反事实置信度依据AUC（CCG-AUC）。该指标用于衡量……
tldr: 提出DualRead方法，将能力学习与置信度估计相分离，通过读取冻结的GRPO训练医学视觉语言模型actor的内部状态（结合回答前可解性评估与回答后视觉支持评估）来校准置信度，并引入CCG-AUC指标评估置信度是否真正基于视觉证据。
en_tdlr: DualRead separates capability learning from confidence estimation by reading reliability from the internal states of a frozen GRPO-trained medical VLM actor, combining pre-answer solvability with post-answer visual support assessment, and introduces CCG-AUC to measure whether confidence is truly grounded in visual evidence.
